verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as many entities or filings, are a fair axis for a registered-agent and entity-compliance service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes: the main host is walled behind a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it. No product content documents any bulk-operation capability, so the verdict is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
